title: Chapter 236: Zerg Firepower Continues To Increase
content:
Chapter 236: Zerg Firepower Continues To Increase

The formation of the infantry phalanx of the alien army is wider, with a scale of more than 500,000 troops. With their average defense ability, it is not easy for the Zerg to quickly destroy them.

The Zerg host observed that without the continuous attack of the Zerg destroyer, the alien army stabilized the battle situation in the main camp and began to slowly shrink the front line, drawing more troops to form a second infantry phalanx and marching towards the Zerg army.

Without the support of the Zerg army's ultra-long-range firepower, the offensive of the local camp army weakened again. There is still a big gap between their combat power and that of the alien army.

For the Zerg army, they can only play a certain role in restraining.

If the wave after wave of offensives of the alien army are really connected, even if the Zerg army can finally defend successfully, it will suffer heavy losses.

The difference in the strength of the two sides is very large. The total strength of the Zerg army is only over 500,000.

Therefore, the firepower of the Zerg destroyers cannot be pinned down by the heavy cavalry of the alien race, which is as difficult to break as iron beans. The 50,000 Zerg destroyers must use the advantage of range to consume the huge infantry phalanx of the alien army.

Without the powerful firepower of the Zerg destroyers, only a small number of Zerg hydralisks, Zerg cockroaches and Zerg stealth spiders can directly attack the heavy cavalry of the alien race due to the influence of the shooting range.

This greatly reduced the pressure on the heavy cavalry of the alien race!

"What a tough enemy!"

Wu Qing had to sigh at the strength of the alien army!

The more than a thousand powerful heavy cavalry of the alien race who rushed to the front had only a small number of casualties. They were less suppressed by the firepower of the Zerg destroyers, and their speed of advancement was faster.

The trapping net of the Zerg queen could not stop their pace of advancement. Although the speed slowed down, they were still moving forward!

Wu Qing couldn't stand the situation of insufficient firepower and inability to hit the enemy. He selected ten Zerg Exploding Swarms that he didn't want to use, and upgraded them to five stars in the air without paying attention to other people's eyes.

Now everyone is no longer surprised that the Zerg's troops are improving their strength on the battlefield. The few people who saw the ten Zerg Exploding Swarms upgraded just sighed: "What star level did these Zerg troops originally reach?"

Everyone believes that the soldiers in the Zerg army originally had a high star level, but now they have dropped their star levels, so they can upgrade their star levels on the battlefield so quickly through luck.

Ten Zerg Exploding Swarms upgraded to five stars broke out of their cocoons and flew towards the more than a thousand powerful alien heavy cavalry in front of the Zerg army.

The five-star strength gives the Zerg Exploding Swarms a terrible flying speed. They accelerate and dive in the final stage of the attack, and ordinary people can't see their shadows at all.

The alien heavy cavalry, who had no air defense capabilities, had no way to deal with the Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes' attack even if they could detect it.

"Boom......!" A super loud noise covered up the noise caused by the attack of 50,000 Zerg Destroyers, and the sound covered the entire battlefield!

Even the very stable energy between heaven and earth had a little fluctuation.

The self-detonation attack of ten five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquitoes made the creatures on the entire battlefield feel the heart, and their eyes were all attracted to the direction where the huge explosion came from.

The Zerg army phalanx was hit by a huge energy shock, and some Zergs were also slightly damaged.

This was still a distance almost as far as the Zerg cockroach's range, so the situation at the center of the explosion can be imagined!

The super corrosive mucus splashed out, and there was a "sizzling" corrosion sound everywhere!

At the center of the explosion, a large pit appeared at the location of the more than a thousand powerful alien heavy cavalrymen who were directly attacked. In the pit, except for ten knights with broken armor who could barely stand, the other knights and horses disappeared, leaving only armored weapons on the ground.

The ten surviving human knights had exhausted their energy and were severely injured, basically losing their combat power.

Their warhorses, which were slightly weaker, all died and disappeared in light.

"A five-star-strength soldier sacrificed himself to achieve the strongest lethality. Such destructive power is said to be caused by a six-star strongman. Some people believe it!"

"This kind of self-destructive attack threat is really terrifying! And it is impossible to defend against it! It is really a terrible soldier!"

"There seems to be a small group of such soldiers in the air!"

"..."

The powerful attack of the Zerg self-destructing mosquito killed a thousand-strong alien cavalrymen in one blow, which shocked people again.

This battle of the Zerg army brought too many shocks to everyone.

A group of two-star Zerg puppies emerged from the ground in front of the Zerg army and rushed towards the surviving knights in the pit.

A Zerg queen sprayed out a trap net, which trapped ten five-star alien human heavy knights who still had traces of the trap net on their bodies, making them unable to move.

Ten Zerg queens that had been upgraded to five stars quietly released parasitic control parasites on ten five-star human heavy knights to interfere with the ten fanatical believers of the Lord of Light who were very determined to resist.

The other alien heavy cavalrymen affected by the five-star Zerg Explosive Mosquito self-explosion were very close to the center of the explosion, and this explosion also caused them heavy losses.

Seeing the Zerg puppies rushing towards the pit created by the explosion, the alien heavy cavalrymen instinctively wanted to rush forward to stop the Zerg puppies' actions, although they could not see the situation in the pit.

Unfortunately, the effect of the trapping nets on their bodies did not weaken at all, restricting their actions.

At this time, the Zerg biological decomposition liquid sprayed by the Zerg Hydralisk fell like rain again.

This liquid is very terrible. When it falls on the body, it can increase their various consumption several times.

The companions who were exhausted by the fierce attack, the heavy armor with strong defensive ability on their bodies, under the erosion of this liquid, the defense was rapidly weakened, and then penetrated, and when it came into contact with the body, it would melt the flesh and bones.

This forced them to spend their minds to deal with this terrible liquid that was everywhere.

After the Zerg Hydralisk sprayed a round of Zerg biological decomposition liquid, it launched an armor-piercing spike attack on the alien heavy cavalry within the range, knocking the slow-moving heavy cavalry to the ground like a target, and then turned into light and disappeared.

The Zerg puppy sent by Wu Qing successfully captured ten five-star knights of the alien race. These ten five-star knights were resisting the parasitic control of the control parasites in their minds and had no resistance at all.

The reason why Wu Qing wanted to capture a few aliens was to obtain some information from them. The parasitic control of the Zerg Queen basically would not destroy the memory of the creatures controlled by the parasites.

Moreover, the damage caused by this parasite is considered a physical damage, and no matter how strong the will and fanatical faith are, it is ineffective against it.

Seeing that a knight was captured alive, the alien race seemed to have suffered a great humiliation. The heavy cavalry troops in the front could not rush forward, and the heavy cavalry blocked in the back began to maneuver to both sides, trying to bypass it.

But the Zerg Queen would not let them have their way. When the Terran heavy cavalry in the rear circled around and finally rushed to the front, the Zerg Queen's trap net came down and caught them firmly.

The Zerg Queen's trap net grew up in the wind in an instant and covered them all at once. Even if they knew there was such an attack, they couldn't hide.

The Terran heavy cavalry's charge formation was stretched out in this way. The Zerg Hydralisks and Stealth Spiders, which were originally at the edge of the range, were now within reach and attacked the Terran heavy cavalry that rushed up from both sides and were caught by the Queen's net.

This accelerated the loss rate of the Terran heavy cavalry to a certain extent, but without the Zerg Destroyer's covering fire attack, the Zerg long-range troops that were now stuck in the range were not very efficient in killing the enemy.

The infantry phalanx following the heavy cavalry of the alien race was about to catch up with the cavalry in front, and they were hit hard by the Zerg destroyers again.

A round of attack of 50,000 liquid fireball shells can fire several rounds in a very short time. As the range becomes shorter, the firing rate of the Zerg destroyers also becomes faster.

Such intensive area killing attacks fell on the infantry phalanx of the alien army, whose defense ability was relatively weak compared to the heavy cavalry, causing large-scale casualties.

Moreover, the attack damage of the Zerg destroyers was continuous. With each additional round of attack, the condition of the infantry phalanx of the alien army would be worse.

The loss would be greater when the next round of attack by the Zerg destroyers was received.

This is a vicious cycle!

Those priests accompanying the army constantly consumed the energy of faith and cast divine arts to reduce the casualties of the army.

"The firepower output is still a little weak!"

Wu Qing saw that the Zerg army was not destroying the enemy fast enough, and his old problem of insufficient firepower phobia came back again.

The system has gained a lot of resources to destroy the enemy of the alien army, and now the energy and gas are sufficient.

Wu Qing selected ten Zerg destroyers and upgraded them to five-star on the spot. He wanted to test the killing efficiency of the five-star Zerg destroyers first.

The ten Zerg destroyers upgraded to five-star, all recovered, and became a little bigger. They immediately launched an attack on the infantry phalanx of the alien army.

"Boom boom...!"

Ten special liquid fireball shells smashed into the infantry phalanx of the alien army at a faster speed. The more terrifying explosion blew a large area of the surrounding alien infantry, most of which were one-star strength, into light and disappeared.

The gap in strength between the two sides was too big. Even if the defense of the one-star soldiers was strong, they could not defend against this kind of attack.

Moreover, after being attacked by multiple explosions, the defense capabilities of most of the alien infantry were already very weak.

The powerful attack launched by the five-star Zerg destroyers achieved an excellent killing effect.

Without saying a word, Wu Qing directly upgraded the Zerg Destroyers, ignoring the massive consumption of resources, and increased the number of five-star Zerg Destroyers to one thousand.
